facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Guaranteed Capital: Yes after Phase Zero and final cohort selection
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: After successful 4-week virtual Phase Zero and official selection into 16-week curriculum
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: US$100K SAFE; exact cap/discount in current offer docs/terms.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Company must be incorporated in Puerto Rico or US and authorized to do business in Puerto Rico if selected; at least 2 full-time founders.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Innovative early-stage startup ≤3 years operations; prepared to raise a round within 6 months of program start; ≥2 full-time founders; team leader available for 16 weeks in Puerto Rico.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 4-week virtual Phase Zero, then 16-week program in Puerto Rico; team leader must participate in Puerto Rico.
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — global, subject to PR/US incorporation/authorization if selected
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
